dict.string: Nubi reads and controls playback in Apple Music, Spotify, and YouTube tabs in Chrome when automatic detection is enabled.
Nubi shows upcoming calendar events in Home and Calendar. It does not change events.
Nubi routes audio from playing applications to let you control their volumes independently. Audio is processed in memory and never recorded.
Nubi uses your location only to show current weather when you choose to enable it.

Nubi shows a temporary camera preview when you choose to open it. Video is not recorded or saved.
